name: Ares Jezero Delta Research Base
tagline: Sustain a self-reliant human research base on the Red Planet.
description: Lead an expedition in Mars' Jezero Crater delta. Operate with reduced solar flux (43% of Earth/Moon), survive multi-sol regional dust storms that choke solar power, manage subsurface water recovery, and grow hydroponic food.

environmental_constraints.atmosphere: Thin CO2 (95% CO2, ~0.6 kPa) — Modest radiation buffer, frequent dust storms

major_hazards: Regional and global Martian dust storms cutting solar array output by 50–80%
Lower baseline solar irradiance due to Mars' 1.52 AU distance from the Sun
Long communication delay with Earth requiring autonomous emergency triage
High water & power demand to sustain hydroponic food production

objectives.title: Maintain crew survival for the full mission duration
Keep Water reserves above critical threshold (40 L)
Operate an active Hydroponic Greenhouse or Water Recycler
Accumulate at least 50 Planetary Science Points
